result.title: LiveAsset: Learning Intent Assets from Corrective Interactions for Agent Runtime Control
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents acting across web applications and online services often need multi-turn corrections to align their work with users' underspecified goals and preferences. In practice, users may identify problems in the current outcome without specifying the desired result, so learning user intentions requires interpreting each correction against the agent's preceding and revised outcomes. These expectations are often connected to a particular context, making it hard to know when they apply and how to ensure the agent later acts as the user expects. To this end, we propose LiveAsset, an intent harness that learns reusable intent assets from corrective interactions and uses them for runtime control of agent execution. LiveAsset jointly interprets each correction with the agent's original and revised results to infer user intent, incrementally updating the assets while preserving earlier requirements that remain applicable. The learned requirements guide agent execution from task entry and provide criteria for runtime verification, which uses the explanations to assess applicability before each reply is delivered and directs the agent to revise the result to address unmet requirements while preserving those already satisfied. Following a learning phase in which simulated users progressively reveal requirements through multi-turn corrections, we evaluate LiveAsset using same-task replay of the original requests on π-Bench, PERMA, and Vita and cross-task transfer on PAST-Bench and SkillEvolBench. Experiments show that LiveAsset better fulfills requirements learned from corrective interactions and improves performance on these benchmarks compared with memory, skill, and rule-based harness baselines. Code is available at github.com/landian60/LiveAsset.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LiveAsset，从多轮纠正交互中结合原始与修订结果推断用户意图，增量维护可复用的 intent assets，并在运行时以其引导执行、在回复前校验适用性并驱动修订。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「纠正解释—保留既有约束的增量状态更新—运行前适用性校验与修订」流程，可能为 latent 推理状态的需求表示、验证信号与修订时机提供方法线索，但对象为纯文本 agent 且无视觉证据，迁移可行性需核查。
